summary: Preserve canonical Evolution Journal filtering, status projection, and Persona lineage before pagination. Ensure decision_state precedence and lightweight field normalization (proposed_changes summary, linked_incident_id, linked_postmortem_id) so filtering by status matches rendered row status and full summary counts reflect canonical states without deep hydration outside sliced pages.
root_cause: Lightweight pre-filter projection in evolution/router.py duplicated canonical mutation_review_projection fields but preferred status before decision_state, causing approved items to be filtered out under ?status=approved and returned under ?status=pending. Full-summary mixed normalized returned rows and unnormalized off-page rows. Initial record also omitted linked_incident_id and linked_postmortem_id used by Persona lineage filtering.

solution.router: In services/control-plane/bff/evolution/router.py, apply canonical decision_state precedence to both decision and mutation review items in the pre-filter loop. Populate proposed_changes summary, linked_incident_id, and linked_postmortem_id in lightweight projection, and resolve postmortem_ids in Persona lineage matching so items linked via incident or postmortem are correctly matched before pagination.

acceptance_criteria_verification.ac1: Read actual final PR6626 source and reproduced contradictory approved/pending filtering on base with sanitized counterexample /tmp/pantheon-assist-20261013/Evolution-e4cbc-real-mounted-filter-regression-actual-tool-result-20261017.json (defect_reproduced changed from true on base to false on head).
acceptance_criteria_verification.ac2: Preserved canonical GovernanceService.mutation_review_projection field semantics before slicing, including decision_state precedence and proposed_changes summary default.
acceptance_criteria_verification.ac3: Preserved Persona lineage filtering through linked_incident_id and linked_postmortem_id. Deep authoritative hydration remains bounded strictly to returned page_items with 0 per-row store lookups for off-page rows.
acceptance_criteria_verification.ac4: Added mounted base-fail/head-pass unit tests in test_bff_b3_evolution_journal.py covering divergent status/decision_state filtering, full summary consistency across history sizes, and Persona lineage through linked incident/postmortem references with assertions on bounded owner reads. Net production line change is +20 lines, within budget <= 30.
